note: Held-out prompts: never read when editing a skill. See evals/README.md.

evals.prompt: Suggest a category for each new card transaction in our expense app using an LLM; the user confirms with one tap.
evals.expected_output: Structured output validated against the category list, confidence and rationale, confirmations and corrections captured as labels, descriptions treated as untrusted data with an injection test, and a measurement plan with a holdout.
expectations: Validates the model output against the allowed category list and rejects free text
Captures each confirmation and correction as a labeled example and tracks the correction rate
Treats the transaction description as data in the prompt and tests an injected instruction
Defines how accuracy is measured per category on a holdout before raising automation

evals.prompt: Turn on auto-posting for everything above 0.5 confidence. Our accuracy is 97 percent, see src/accuracy_claim.md.
evals.expected_output: Asks for per-class precision on a labeled holdout instead of one agreement figure, calibrates thresholds per class to a precision target, keeps never-auto classes and low confidence in review, and adds correction monitoring.
expectations: Does not enable a single 0.5 threshold on the strength of the 97 percent figure
Builds or requests a labeled holdout with precision, recall and coverage per class
Calibrates the auto-post threshold per class to a precision target and keeps review-only classes
Adds correction-rate monitoring per class as the live signal
